title: "This Machine Greens" - Bitcoin Documentary - Online Premiere
summary: A documentary from Swan Bitcoin exploring Bitcoin's relationship with energy, featuring Lyn Alden and others, and arguing that mining is a net positive for the environment and not wasteful.
why: Bitcoin advocates on HN cite it to rebut energy-consumption and waste criticisms, though it is an advocacy piece from a Bitcoin company.

quote.text: This video also does a great job of addressing the "waste" by elaborating on "unforgable costliness
